questions.question: In David's psalm about corrupt people, what does the fool say in his heart?

answers.text: That God is angry with him
That God is on his side

questions.question: In David's psalm, God looks down from heaven on all people. What is He looking to see?

answers.text: If any understand and seek Him
If any are strong enough to rule
If any have built Him an altar
